propositions: Operator-attested evidence location and agent authorship were conflated in documentation, creating confusion about who may author external attestations
Adding the [operator-attested] tag to a criterion after plan certification invalidates the signed plan material as stale, preventing reuse of the completion review without a fresh execution review
The completion-verifier remediation guidance instructs callers to edit description text after plan review, which conflicts with the material-pinning anti-tamper design that rejects such edits
Documentation must clarify that agents may freely record truthful concrete evidence they observed, provided the criterion is classified before plan review
The proper ordering is: classify evidence kind by adding the [operator-attested] tag before plan review, then record concrete evidence in non-material ticket comments after certification
